subject: Next steps: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan (Acme)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Next steps: Evaluation kickoff and trial plan (Acme)

Jordan — thanks again for taking the discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your evaluation started: 

Recap:
- Goal: run a 4-week evaluation to validate Redwood’s inference runtime on Acme’s customer-facing summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria (from our convo): latency < 250ms p50, per-token cost target, and fidelity on a 200-prompt test set (~95% pass on B/QA metrics).
- Key stakeholders: you (PM), your security lead (it-security@acmecorp.com), and a backend engineer for the deep dive.

Proposed next steps:
1) Evaluation kickoff (trial plan walk-through + tech deep dive) — ~60–90m. I attached a draft trial plan and prompt-set template.
2) We’ll align on success criteria and the prompt/test set you’ll run during the trial.
3) We’ll provision trial capacity and share access + runbook.

Available slots (PT) next week — please let me know which works or share times that work for your team:
- Tue 6/16 10:00–11:30am PT
- Wed 6/17 1:00–2:30pm PT
- Fri 6/19 9:00–10:30am PT

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholders who should join the kickoff (security + one backend engineer)? Also please fill out the prompt-set template I attached with 20 representative prompts so we can baseline results during the kick-off.

Attachments:
- redwood-eval-trial-plan.pdf (draft trial plan, metrics, provisioning steps)
- acme-prompt-set-template.xlsx (20-row prompt template)

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots open till EOD Monday.

Best,
Marissa Cole
